model_type: Locally generated drawing-derived simplified envelope; not native manufacturer or KiCad CAD
license: Project-authored simple geometry derived from published dimensional facts; upstream KiCad package-model license does not describe this model.

sources.document: Manufacturer-authored AMASS XT60PW-M V1.2 drawing, public reseller mirror

datum: Contact1 origin. Body X centered on two power contacts(3.6 mm). Body rear edge PCB Y=+1.85 mm. STEP Y is negative footprint Y. Zero model rotation/offset; unit scale.
simplifications: Body is a filled rectangular bounding box; rounded corners, mating cavity, mould details and optional rear cover omitted.
Below-board tail volumes are clearance blocks at the verified hole extents, not exact contact-metal profiles.
Current catalog dimensions are nominal with no listed tolerance; do not call this a maximum tolerance envelope.
Datum and hole map come from the older exact-MPN V1.2 drawing. Current catalog does not provide a complete hole-position drawing; incoming physical parts/revision must be checked before PCB release.
No mating plug, bend-radius, cable pull-out or assembly standoff allowance is modeled.

unavailable_native_model.upstream_result: Exact horizontal file absent from installed library and official GitLab/GitHub repository; available vertical models are not substitutes.
